review_question: Identify true independent experimental or sampling unit
minimum_evidence: Person/specimen/site ID and uniqueness contract

review_question: Validate outcome scale and measurement unit
minimum_evidence: Dictionary: continuous, binary, nominal, ordinal, count, event-time or assay counts

review_question: Specify eligible denominator and exclusions
minimum_evidence: N enrolled, N eligible, N observed and explicit percentage base

review_question: Document missing outcomes and their mechanism
minimum_evidence: Missing and excluded n, timing, reasons, plan for sensitivity

review_question: Confirm between-unit independence
minimum_evidence: Unique person/cluster IDs and randomization/sampling design

review_question: Validate matched IDs and order of measurements
minimum_evidence: Exactly aligned pre/post IDs, visit labels, complete-pair policy

review_question: Confirm comparator groups and reference levels
minimum_evidence: Declared groups, counts, primary contrast and coding

review_question: Specify target estimand and direction before testing
minimum_evidence: Difference, ratio, probability, trend or association direction

review_question: Inspect data distribution and influential observations
minimum_evidence: Distribution plots, outliers and residual justification; not normality pretest alone

review_question: Assess common-variance assumption if required
minimum_evidence: Variance by group; model choice and heteroscedasticity sensitivity

review_question: Check contingency counts and reference distribution
minimum_evidence: Observed/expected integer cells and exact-vs-asymptotic rationale

review_question: Preserve ordered-category semantics
minimum_evidence: Document stage/grade order and ties; no arbitrary equal spacing

review_question: Verify count exposure or person-time
minimum_evidence: Strictly positive exposure and event counting window/units

review_question: Check count-model mean-variance and zero process
minimum_evidence: Dispersion diagnostics, zero excess and repeat-event independence

review_question: Define entry time and common time zero
minimum_evidence: Eligibility, baseline/start date and at-risk-entry rules

review_question: Validate event/censor coding and competing events
minimum_evidence: Event definitions, observed follow-up, censoring mechanism

review_question: Check survival modeling assumptions
minimum_evidence: PH diagnostics or a prespecified alternative estimand

review_question: Identify within-person, site or assay correlation
minimum_evidence: Cluster key, visit schedule and correlation-aware model

review_question: Confirm complex survey sampling variables
minimum_evidence: Weights, PSU, strata, target population and design degrees of freedom

review_question: Prespecify plausible confounder strategy
minimum_evidence: Covariate timing, DAG/clinical rationale, functional forms

review_question: Prespecify multiplicity family and adjustment
minimum_evidence: Primary hypotheses, planned contrasts, FWER or FDR strategy

review_question: Validate biological assay and replicate structure
minimum_evidence: Raw-count status, library size, person/specimen alignment and batch

review_question: Separate predictive development from independent evaluation
minimum_evidence: Participant-level split, calibration, leakage audit and external validity

review_question: Inspect fitted model diagnostics before inference
minimum_evidence: Residuals, leverage, functional form, convergence and separation

review_question: Define observable endpoint and ascertainment window
minimum_evidence: pCR/pathology, recurrence, toxicity or measurement protocol with time horizon
